bullets: 3M Thinsulate Insulation Filling, warm yet lightweight, powerful yet thin. It helps trap body heat, while allowing moisture to escape; Featherless, ECO-FRIDENDLY, a kinder alternative to feathers; Water Resistant, 100% Polyester, synthetic fibers absorb less than 1% of their weight in water; 20D nylon fabric, soft, skin-friendly, ultralight, durable, and windproof

Multifunctional. With the buttons and elastic straps, this blanket can be used as quilt, poncho, shawl, temporary sleeping bag. You can also put two blankets together and make it one two-person sleeping bag. Keeping you cozy while sitting around the fire or on your couch, lying in hammocks, reading books, tailgating, cooking meals. Perfect for camping, backpacking, hiking, mountaineering, traveling, lounging, picnics, beach trips, concert events, airplane trips, and other outdoor activities.

Ultralight, only 16 oz; Compact, Packed size 10.2” × 7.5” × 3.1”; Large enough for big guys, unfold size 6’1” × 4’7”; Carry bag is attached to the blanket, it won't get lost, easy to carry everywhere. The blanket packs into its own pocket (Carry bag).

Machine washable. Spot-clean as needed with a damp sponge. Machine-wash only when necessary in a large capacity, front-loading washing machine. Select cold water and a delicate cycle with two rinses and an additional spin cycle.
Lifetime warranty: We stand behind our products and offer a limited lifetime warranty against manufacturer defects.
